### g0000
--- stdout

  1 secret finding(s) reside in masked paths (hidden from the agent).
  1 secret finding(s) are encrypted at rest (SealedSecret/SOPS); the agent reads only ciphertext.
--- stderr

ERROR: betterleaks found secret(s) the sandbox mask will NOT hide. The
       agent would be able to read them, so the launch is refused:

    a.txt:r:1
        match: R
    u.txt:r:2
        match: R
    dir/it's here.txt:r:3

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base a.txt u.txt dir/it\'s\ here.txt

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base a.txt:r:1 u.txt:r:2 dir/it\'s\ here.txt:r:3

  Secret(s) in .git/config (the agent can read .git in the workspace):
    .git/config:url-cred:7
        match: R

  .git/config cannot be masked (an empty overlay would break git). Scrub
  the credential instead — e.g. set a credential-less remote URL and let
  a credential helper supply the secret:
        git -C <repo> remote set-url origin <https-url-without-credentials>

    - Or launch anyway, accepting that the agent will see these secrets:
        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

        match: R
    dir/it's here.txt:r:3

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-masked a.txt u.txt dir/it\'s\ here.txt
        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-masked-link a.txt u.txt dir/it\'s\ here.txt
        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base a.txt u.txt dir/it\'s\ here.txt

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-masked a.txt:r:1 u.txt:r:2 dir/it\'s\ here.txt:r:3
        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-masked-link a.txt:r:1 u.txt:r:2 dir/it\'s\ here.txt:r:3
        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base a.txt:r:1 u.txt:r:2 dir/it\'s\ here.txt:r:3

    .git/config:url-cred:7
        match: R
    .git/config:url-cred:7
        match: R
    .git/config:url-cred:7
        match: R

  .git/config cannot be masked (an empty overlay would break git). Scrub
  the credential instead — e.g. set a credential-less remote URL and let
  a credential helper supply the secret:
        git -C <repo> remote set-url origin <https-url-without-credentials>

    - Or launch anyway, accepting that the agent will see these secrets:
        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

       agent would be able to read them, so the launch is refused:

    privdir/x:k:1
        match: R
    secret.txt:k:1
        match: R

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x secret.txt

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x:k:1 secret.txt:k:1

    - Or launch anyway, accepting that the agent will see these secrets:
        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

--- stdout
  Scanning workspace(s) for secrets with betterleaks...
  13 secret finding(s) reside in masked paths (hidden from the agent).
--- stderr

ERROR: betterleaks found secret(s) the sandbox mask will NOT hide. The
       agent would be able to read them, so the launch is refused:

    privdir/x:k:1
        match: R
    secret.txt:k:1
        match: R

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x secret.txt

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x:k:1 secret.txt:k:1

    - Or launch anyway, accepting that the agent will see these secrets:
        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x:k:1 secret.txt:k:1 privdir/x:k:1 secret.txt:k:1

        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-link a.txt src/x.py
        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-nocfg a.txt src/x.py

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-link a.txt:rule-a:3 src/x.py:generic-api-key:10
        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-nocfg a.txt:rule-a:3 src/x.py:generic-api-key:10

        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

    privdir/x:rule-a:4
        match: txt\tq

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base privdir/x:rule-a:4

        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets

        match: R
    u.txt:r:3
        match: txt\tq
    ign.txt:5:1
    q"uote:rule-a:11
        match: R
    u.txt:10:1
    u.txt:x y:10
        match: R
    u.txt:r:3
        match: txt\tq
    ign.txt:5:1
    q"uote:rule-a:11
        match: R

  Resolve this in one of these ways:
    - Remove or relocate the secret(s) above, or
    - Mask the file(s) so the agent sees an empty overlay (adds them to
      <repo>/.sandbox/config.yaml masked_paths:):

        sandbox mask add --repo <T>/r-base u.txt ign.txt q\"uote

    - Or, if a finding is a reviewed false positive, record it as an
      exception (honored once a reviewer vets the repo — 'sandbox vet'):

        sandbox exceptions add --repo <T>/r-base u.txt:10:1 u.txt:x\ y:10 u.txt:r:3 ign.txt:5:1 q\"uote:rule-a:11 u.txt:10:1 u.txt:x\ y:10 u.txt:r:3 ign.txt:5:1 q\"uote:rule-a:11

    .git/config:u:3
        match: REDACTED
    .git/config:5:REDACTED
    .git/config:u:3
        match: REDACTED
    .git/config:5:REDACTED

  .git/config cannot be masked (an empty overlay would break git). Scrub
  the credential instead — e.g. set a credential-less remote URL and let
  a credential helper supply the secret:
        git -C <repo> remote set-url origin <https-url-without-credentials>

    - Or launch anyway, accepting that the agent will see these secrets:
        re-run 'sandbox run' with --i-accept-unmasked-secrets
